fusions.name: Last Furlong
fusions.desc: A finishing kick that deals 18 damage and consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.8 times their remaining damage to the hit. Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health. You move 25% faster for 4 seconds after using it.

fusions.name: Scent Mark
fusions.desc: Flicks a scented dart into the first enemy it meets, dealing 4 damage, with a 40% chance to leave it [Marked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Run to Ground
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 40% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Quarry's Toll
fusions.desc: Every hit you land builds a stack on that enemy, up to 6. When you reach 6, they all spend at once: you move and attack 3% faster per stack for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
